local function phase1()
local output=print
local function print(...) output("Key course phase 1:",...) end
local self=require('openmw.self')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local step=1
local frame=0
local points={{util.vector3(1663,3240,-780),util.vector3(1930,3240,-780),util.vector3(2003.264,3034.733,-780)}}
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frame=frame+1
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self) and Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current>0,'Player died on key route')
 if frame==5 then print('Joined key navigation ready') end
 if step>#points then return end
 local p=points[step]
 local done=(step==1 and self.position.y>=3220) or (step==2 and self.position.x>=1910) or (step==3 and math.sqrt((p.x-self.position.x)^2+(p.y-self.position.y)^2)<100)
 if done then print('Joined key waypoint '..step..' reached '..tostring(self.position)) step=step+1 return end
 local t=camera.getViewTransform():inverse()
 local origin=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,0))
 local f=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,-1))-origin
 local d=p-origin
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
 local pitch=math.atan2(f.z,math.sqrt(f.x*f.x+f.y*f.y))-math.atan2(d.z,math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y))
 local gain=camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson and 1 or 2
 local function units(a) return math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(a*5120+.5))) end
 print(string.format('Joined key waypoint %d aim x=%d y=%d',step,units(yaw*gain),units(pitch)))
 if math.abs(yaw)<.04 and math.abs(pitch)<.04 then print('Joined key waypoint '..step..' facing') end
 if frame%15==0 then print('Joined key position '..tostring(self.position)) end
end}}}}

end
local function phase2()
local output=print
local function print(...) output("Key course phase 2:",...) end
local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local probe=require('scripts.tutorial_camera_probe')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local expected=nil
local done=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 local corpse=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x15985a))
 if not corpse or not corpse:isValid() then return end
 local x,y=probe.motion(corpse,'frame',1/5120)
 print(string.format('Sewer corpse aim x=%d y=%d',x,y))
 local source=Actor.inventory(corpse)
 local player=Actor.inventory(self)
 if not expected then
  expected={{}}
  for _,item in ipairs(source:getAll()) do
   local id=item.recordId
   expected[id]=player:countOf(id)+source:countOf(id)
   local record=item.type.record and item.type.record(item)
   print('Sewer corpse item '..id..' count '..source:countOf(id)..' name '..(record and record.name or '?'))
  end
  print('Sewer loot observer ready dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(corpse)))
  print('Sewer view toggle enabled='..tostring(require('openmw.types').Player.getControlSwitch(self,require('openmw.types').Player.CONTROL_SWITCH.ViewMode)))
 end
 if done then return end
 local n=0
 for id,count in pairs(expected) do
  n=n+1
  if source:countOf(id)~=0 or player:countOf(id)~=count then return end
 end
 if n>0 then done=true print('Sewer corpse loot transferred types='..n) end
end}}}}

end
local function phase3()
local output=print
local function print(...) output("Key course phase 3:",...) end
local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local ui=require('openmw.ui')
local input=require('openmw.input')
local frame,sampleFrame,held=0,nil,false
local ready,equipped=false,false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frame=frame+1
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F7)
 if down and not held then sampleFrame=frame+3 end
 if not down then sampleFrame=nil end
 held=down
 if sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame then
  local activeWindow=ui._getActiveControllerWindow()
  if activeWindow=='Inventory' then print('Sewer equipment inventory sampled') end
  if activeWindow=='Magic' then print('Sewer equipment magic sampled') end
 end
 local club=core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x159829)
 local key=core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x159826)
 local inv=Actor.inventory(self)
 local corpse=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x15985a))
 if not ready and inv:countOf(club)==1 and inv:countOf(key)==1 and corpse:isValid() and #Actor.inventory(corpse):getAll()==0 then
  ready=true print('Sewer loot restored key and Club once; corpse empty')
 end
 for slot,item in pairs(Actor.getEquipment(self)) do
  if not equipped and item.recordId==club then equipped=true print('Sewer Club equipped slot='..slot) end
 end
end}}}}

end
local function phase4()
local output=print
local function print(...) output("Key course phase 4:",...) end
local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local probe=require('scripts.tutorial_camera_probe')
local ready,facing,close,entered=false,false,false,false
local sheathed,drawn=false,false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 if not self.cell then return end
 if not sheathed and Actor.getStance(self)==Actor.STANCE.Nothing then sheathed=true print('Sewer Club sheathed') end
 if sheathed and not drawn and Actor.getStance(self)==Actor.STANCE.Weapon then drawn=true print('Sewer Club drawn') end
 if not ready then
  local club=core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x159829)
  local found=false
  for _,item in pairs(Actor.getEquipment(self)) do if item.recordId==club then found=true end end
  assert(found,'Club not equipped after reload')
  assert(Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x159826))==1,'Iron Key missing')
  ready=true print('Sewer keyed route ready; Club equipped and Iron Key retained')
 end
 if self.cell.id==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x22ff6) then
  if not entered then entered=true print('Sewer entered original keyed destination '..self.cell.id) end
  return
 end
 local dx,dy=2240-self.position.x,2944-self.position.y
 local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0))
 local angle=math.atan2(f.y*dx-f.x*dy,f.x*dx+f.y*dy)
 if not facing and math.abs(angle)<.04 then facing=true print('Sewer facing key door') end
 if not close and math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)<110 then close=true print('Sewer key door in range '..tostring(self.position)) end
 local door=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x248b2))
 if door and door:isValid() then local x,y=probe.motion(door,'frame',1/5120) print(string.format('Sewer door aim x=%d y=%d',x,y)) end
end}}}}

end
local input=require('openmw.input')
local phases={{phase1,phase2,phase3,phase4}}
local n=1
local active=phases[n]()
local held=false
local sampleHeld=false
local sampleFrame=nil
local frame=0
print('Key observation phase 1 ready')
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frame=frame+1
 local sample=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F7)
 if sample and not sampleHeld then sampleFrame=frame+3 end
 if not sample then sampleFrame=nil end
 sampleHeld=sample
 if sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame then print("Key camera settled") end
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F8)
 if down and not held then n=n+1 assert(phases[n],'Unexpected key observation phase') active=phases[n]() print('Key observation phase '..n..' ready') end
 held=down
 active.engineHandlers.onFrame(dt)
end}}}}

-- Read-only camera prerequisite for the existing Forward-effect photo window.
local camera = require('openmw.camera')
local core = require('openmw.core')
local nearby = require('openmw.nearby')
local self = require('openmw.self')
local util = require('openmw.util')
local worldMask = nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.World + nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.HeightMap + nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.Door

local function motion(target, mode, radiansPerUnit)
    assert(type(radiansPerUnit) == 'number' and radiansPerUnit > 0 and radiansPerUnit < math.huge)
    local function units(angle)
        return math.max(-8192, math.min(8192, math.floor(angle / radiansPerUnit + 0.5)))
    end
    if mode == 'level' then return 0, units(-camera.getPitch()) end
    if mode == 'upper' then
        -- Standing transitions can retain the previous physical body's bounds
        -- for a frame. Frame the upper body from the logical actor placement;
        -- the separate rendered-mesh prerequisite still checks real visibility.
        local p, t, c = self.position, target.position, camera.getPosition()
        local dx, dy = t.x-p.x, t.y-p.y
        local f = self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0, 1, 0))
        local x = units(math.atan2(f.y*dx-f.x*dy, f.x*dx+f.y*dy))
        local pitch = math.atan2(c.z-t.z-100, math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy))
        return x, units(pitch-camera.getPitch())
    end
    assert(mode == 'frame' or mode == 'aim')
    local anchor = mode == 'frame' and target:getBoundingBox().center
        or target.position + util.vector3(0, 0, 100)
    local p = camera.getViewTransform():apply(anchor)
    local x = units(math.atan2(p.x, -p.z))
    local y = mode == 'aim' and 0 or units(-math.atan2(p.y, math.sqrt(p.x*p.x + p.z*p.z)))
    return x, y
end

local function visible(target, screen)
    local bounds = target:getBoundingBox()
    for _, x in ipairs({{0, -0.65, 0.65}}) do
        for _, y in ipairs({{0, -0.65, 0.65}}) do
            for _, z in ipairs({{0, -0.65, 0.65}}) do
                local anchor = bounds.center + util.vector3(
                    x * bounds.halfSize.x, y * bounds.halfSize.y, z * bounds.halfSize.z)
                local pixel = camera.worldToViewportVector(anchor)
                if camera.getViewTransform():apply(anchor).z < 0
                    and pixel.x >= 0 and pixel.x < screen.x
                    and pixel.y >= 0 and pixel.y < screen.y then
                    if not nearby.castRay(camera.getPosition(), anchor, {{collisionType = worldMask}}).hit then
                        local hit = nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(), anchor, {{ignore = self}}).hitObject
                        if hit and hit.id == target.id then return true end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

-- Require both the head and upper torso inside the viewport, rather than
-- accepting one low-body anchor while the head is cropped above the screen.
local function upperVisible(target, screen)
    local bounds = target:getBoundingBox()
    local top = bounds.center + util.vector3(0, 0, 1.05 * bounds.halfSize.z)
    local projectedTop = camera.worldToViewportVector(top)
    if camera.getViewTransform():apply(top).z >= 0 or projectedTop.x < 16
        or projectedTop.x >= screen.x - 16 or projectedTop.y < 16 or projectedTop.y >= screen.y - 16 then
        return false
    end
    for _, height in ipairs({{0.85, 0.35}}) do
        -- An extended arm/weapon shifts the box centre beside the head or
        -- chest. Require a real target-mesh hit in each band, without assuming
        -- that the centre line passes through the actor's skin.
        local found = false
        for _, x in ipairs({{0, -0.25, 0.25, -0.5, 0.5, -0.75, 0.75}}) do
            for _, y in ipairs({{0, -0.25, 0.25, -0.5, 0.5, -0.75, 0.75}}) do
                local anchor = bounds.center + util.vector3(
                    x * bounds.halfSize.x, y * bounds.halfSize.y, height * bounds.halfSize.z)
                local pixel = camera.worldToViewportVector(anchor)
                if camera.getViewTransform():apply(anchor).z < 0
                    and pixel.x >= 0 and pixel.x < screen.x and pixel.y >= 0 and pixel.y < screen.y
                    and not nearby.castRay(camera.getPosition(), anchor, {{collisionType = worldMask}}).hit then
                    local hit = nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(), anchor, {{ignore = self}}).hitObject
                    if hit and hit.id == target.id then found = true; break end
                end
            end
            if found then break end
        end
        if not found then return false end
    end
    return true
end

local function new(window)
    assert(type(window) == 'number' and window == window and window > 0 and window < math.huge,
        'Forward capture needs a finite positive source window')
    local started
    return function(target, screen)
        local now = core.getSimulationTime()
        started = started or now
        local elapsed = now - started
        if elapsed < 0 or elapsed >= window then return false, false end
        return visible(target, screen), true
    end
end

-- A quiet rendered bounding box is a cheap capture prerequisite. The saved
-- physical bodies and the photograph remain the evidence for the actual pose.
local function newSettled(window, minimum, hold, maximumSpeed)
    for _, value in ipairs({{window, minimum, hold, maximumSpeed}}) do
        assert(type(value) == 'number' and value == value and value >= 0 and value < math.huge)
    end
    assert(hold > 0 and maximumSpeed > 0 and minimum + hold < window)
    local started, previousTime, previousBounds, quietSince
    local function distance(a, b)
        return math.sqrt((a.x-b.x)^2 + (a.y-b.y)^2 + (a.z-b.z)^2)
    end
    return function(target)
        local now = core.getSimulationTime()
        started = started or now
        local elapsed = now - started
        if elapsed < 0 or elapsed >= window then return false, false, elapsed, math.huge end
        local bounds = target:getBoundingBox()
        local speed = math.huge
        if previousTime and now > previousTime then
            speed = math.max(distance(bounds.center, previousBounds.center),
                distance(bounds.halfSize, previousBounds.halfSize)) / (now - previousTime)
            if elapsed >= minimum and speed <= maximumSpeed then
                quietSince = quietSince or now
            else
                quietSince = nil
            end
        elseif previousTime and now < previousTime then
            quietSince = nil
        end
        previousTime, previousBounds = now, bounds
        return quietSince ~= nil and now - quietSince >= hold, true, elapsed, speed
    end
end

local function framedVisible(target, screen)
    local bounds = target:getBoundingBox()
    for _, x in ipairs({{-1, 1}}) do
        for _, y in ipairs({{-1, 1}}) do
            for _, z in ipairs({{-1, 1}}) do
                local anchor = bounds.center + util.vector3(
                    x * bounds.halfSize.x, y * bounds.halfSize.y, z * bounds.halfSize.z)
                local pixel = camera.worldToViewportVector(anchor)
                if camera.getViewTransform():apply(anchor).z >= 0 or pixel.x < 16
                    or pixel.x >= screen.x - 16 or pixel.y < 16 or pixel.y >= screen.y - 16 then
                    return false
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return visible(target, screen)
end

return {{new = new, visible = visible, motion = motion, upperVisible = upperVisible,
    newSettled = newSettled, framedVisible = framedVisible}}
